_說明: 把下方 meeting-room 區塊合併進 Firebase Console → Realtime Database → 規則 的既有 rules JSON（與 walkin-pm 節點並列，不要動其他節點）。ADMIN 判斷用 email；如要更嚴可再加 auth.uid 比對。

newData.hasChildren(['date','s','e','kind','status','name','phone','payMethod','createdAt']) && newData.child('date').val().matches(/^2[0-9]{3}-[0-1][0-9]-[0-3][0-9]$/) && newData.child('s').isNumber() && newData.child('s').val() >= 0 && newData.child('e').isNumber() && newData.child('e').val() > newData.child('s').val() && newData.child('e').val() <= 1440 && (newData.child('kind').val() === 'm' || newData.child('kind').val() === 'v') && (newData.child('status').val() === 'pending' || newData.child('status').val() === 'confirmed' || newData.child('status').val() === 'rejected' || newData.child('status').val() === 'cancelled') && newData.child('name').isString() && newData.child('name').val().length <= 50 && newData.child('phone').isString() && newData.child('phone').val().length <= 20 && (newData.child('payMethod').val() === 'hours' || newData.child('payMethod').val() === 'transfer') && newData.child('createdAt').isNumber()

$token..validate: newData.hasChildren(['name','phone','createdAt']) && newData.child('name').isString() && newData.child('name').val().length <= 50 && newData.child('phone').isString() && newData.child('phone').val().length >= 8 && newData.child('phone').val().length <= 20 && newData.child('createdAt').isNumber()
